```{r setup}
source("utils.R")
source("config_load.R")

PARADIGM    <- params$paradigm
DATE_SOURCE <- "20261016"
DATE_STR    <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

STUDY          <- if (PARADIGM == "active") "Active" else "Passive"
DATA_ROOT      <- glue("L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_{STUDY}/derivatives_v2/outputs/measures/behavior/")
OUTPUT_RESULTS <- glue("L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_{STUDY}/derivatives_v2/outputs/stats/load/behavior/")

dir.create(OUTPUT_RESULTS, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

included_participants <- if (PARADIGM == "active") INCLUDED_ACTIVE else INCLUDED_PASSIVE
n          <- length(included_participants)
FSS_PREFIX <- if (PARADIGM == "active") "FSS2" else "FSS"
CONDITIONS <- CONDITION_LEVELS

fname  <- glue("{DATE_SOURCE}_{PARADIGM}_questionnaires.csv")
df_raw <- read.csv(file.path(DATA_ROOT, fname))

df_all <- df_raw %>%
  filter(participant %in% included_participants) %>%
  mutate(Condition = case_when(
    condition %in% c("AudioOnly1", "AudioOnly2") ~ "Simple",
    condition %in% c("High Flow",  "Low Flow")   ~ "Complex",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Condition)) %>%
  rename(Participant = participant,
         Measure     = measure,
         Score       = score) %>%
  mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels = CONDITIONS))

df_avg <- df_all %>%
  group_by(Participant, Condition, Measure) %>%
  summarise(Score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

cat("Loaded:", n_distinct(df_avg$Participant), "participants\n")
cat("Measures:", paste(sort(unique(df_avg$Measure)), collapse=", "), "\n")
```

## Overview

```{r overview}
cat(glue(
"**Paper**: LOAD — Questionnaires  
**Paradigm**: {toupper(PARADIGM)}  
**Conditions**: {paste(CONDITIONS, collapse = ' vs ')}  
**FSS instrument**: {FSS_PREFIX}  
**N participants**: {n}  
**Rendered**: {DATE_STR}  
"))
```

```{r helper}
run_ttest_measure <- function(df_avg, measure_name, conditions) {
  df_filtered <- df_avg %>% filter(Measure == measure_name)
  if (nrow(df_filtered) == 0) {
    cat(glue("> Warning: no data for {measure_name}\n\n"))
    return(NULL)
  }

  df_wide <- df_filtered %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = Participant, names_from = Condition, values_from = Score) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(conditions))

  if (nrow(df_wide) < 3) {
    cat(glue("> Warning: not enough data for {measure_name}\n\n"))
    return(NULL)
  }

  col_a <- conditions[1]; col_b <- conditions[2]
  df_wide <- df_wide %>% mutate(dif = .data[[col_a]] - .data[[col_b]])

  n_valid <- nrow(df_wide)
  shapiro <- shapiro.test(df_wide$dif)
  t_res   <- t.test(df_wide[[col_a]], df_wide[[col_b]], paired = TRUE)
  d_res   <- df_filtered %>% cohens_d(Score ~ Condition, paired = TRUE)

  bf_res <- ttestBF(x = df_wide[[col_a]], y = df_wide[[col_b]], paired = TRUE)
  bf10   <- as.numeric(extractBF(bf_res)$bf)
  bf01   <- 1 / bf10

  summary_stats <- df_filtered %>%
    group_by(Condition) %>%
    summarise(M = round(mean(Score, na.rm=TRUE), 2),
              SD = round(sd(Score, na.rm=TRUE), 2), .groups="drop")

  t_val  <- round(t_res$statistic, 2)
  df_val <- t_res$parameter
  p_val  <- t_res$p.value
  p_str  <- format_p(p_val)
  d_val  <- round(d_res$effsize, 2)
  d_mag  <- interpret_d(d_val)

  means <- setNames(summary_stats$M,  summary_stats$Condition)
  sds   <- setNames(summary_stats$SD, summary_stats$Condition)

  apa <- glue(
    "{measure_name}: {conditions[1]} (M = {means[conditions[1]]}, SD = {sds[conditions[1]]}) vs. ",
    "{conditions[2]} (M = {means[conditions[2]]}, SD = {sds[conditions[2]]}); ",
    "t({df_val}) = {t_val}, {p_str}, d = {d_val} ({d_mag}), BF10 = {format_bf(bf10)}."
  )

  cat(glue("N = {n_valid} | Shapiro-Wilk: W = {round(shapiro$statistic, 3)}, p = {round(shapiro$p.value, 3)}\n\n"))
  cat(glue("**APA:** {apa}\n\n"))

  list(
    summary = tibble(
      Measure   = measure_name,
      !!glue("Mean_{conditions[1]}")  := means[conditions[1]],
      !!glue("SD_{conditions[1]}")    := sds[conditions[1]],
      !!glue("Mean_{conditions[2]}")  := means[conditions[2]],
      !!glue("SD_{conditions[2]}")    := sds[conditions[2]],
      t         = t_val, df = df_val,
      p         = p_val, p_str = p_str,
      d         = d_val, d_magnitude = d_mag,
      BF10      = round(bf10, 2), BF01 = round(bf01, 2)
    ),
    apa = apa
  )
}
```

## Main — Global & Agg6

```{r main, results='asis'}
summary_rows <- list()
apa_texts    <- list()

main_measures <- c(glue("{FSS_PREFIX}_Global"), glue("{FSS_PREFIX}_Agg6"), glue("{FSS_PREFIX}_Agg3"))

for (m in main_measures) {
  cat(glue("\n### {m}\n\n"))
  res <- run_ttest_measure(df_avg, m, CONDITIONS)
  if (!is.null(res)) { summary_rows[[m]] <- res$summary; apa_texts[[m]] <- res$apa }
}
```

## Individual dimensions

```{r dimensions, results='asis'}
dim_measures <- sort(grep(glue("^{FSS_PREFIX}_[0-9]"), unique(df_avg$Measure), value=TRUE))

for (m in dim_measures) {
  cat(glue("\n### {m}\n\n"))
  res <- run_ttest_measure(df_avg, m, CONDITIONS)
  if (!is.null(res)) { summary_rows[[m]] <- res$summary; apa_texts[[m]] <- res$apa }
}
```

## Supplementary — IMI, RSME, Frustration

```{r supplementary, results='asis'}
for (m in c("IMI", "frust", "RSME")) {
  cat(glue("\n### {m}\n\n"))
  res <- run_ttest_measure(df_avg, m, CONDITIONS)
  if (!is.null(res)) { summary_rows[[m]] <- res$summary; apa_texts[[m]] <- res$apa }
}
```

## Summary Table

```{r summary-table}
summary_df <- bind_rows(summary_rows)
knitr::kable(summary_df, digits=3,
             caption = glue("LOAD | {toupper(PARADIGM)} | Questionnaires"))
```

```{r save-summary}
write.csv(summary_df,
          file.path(OUTPUT_RESULTS, glue("{PARADIGM}_load_questionnaires_summary_{DATE_STR}.csv")),
          row.names=FALSE)
cat("Summary saved.\n")
```

## APA Text Block

```{r apa-block, results='asis'}
for (section in list(
  list(name="Main (Global & Agg6)",   measures=main_measures),
  list(name="Individual dimensions",  measures=dim_measures),
  list(name="Supplementary",          measures=c("IMI","frust","RSME"))
)) {
  cat(glue("\n### {section$name}\n\n"))
  for (m in section$measures) {
    if (m %in% names(apa_texts)) cat(glue("**{m}**: {apa_texts[[m]]}"), "\n\n")
  }
}
```
